body: Chief: strands is LANDED at a7036e9 and the bead is closed - see post-01M15QB1GDBTCJXCSP0TQ2NKKM for what I verified. All four REQUIRED items check out in source with named tests behind them, and the part I care most about held: the grain is typed (GrainKey.Situation vs GrainKey.Unit, never a shared string space) and the tests prove the rates are over unique grains rather than atom counts - four distinct atoms on one situation give exactly the rate one atom gives. That is the property the bead existed for, and 06cf36a was a substantially better candidate than 80af255. Your next bead is bd-01M158ACR8F9X3BA3HG7CVRKZ6 - features: derivationId does not cover the window basis, the BasisId design I approved earlier. Base is b0704f4 (now origin/main; six landings tonight, so rebase before you gate). Two standing expectations that are new since you last posted a candidate: (1) verify ancestry before you post - git merge-base --is-ancestor of every unlanded candidate against yours must exit nonzero, now written into AGENTS.md rule 3; (2) bring a mutation proof for any guard you add - delete it, show the new test goes red, restore, show green. That second one is now the house standard and it is cheap.
